research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Altay Therapeutics is engaged in the research and development of small molecule therapies targeting chronic inflammatory conditions. Their work includes the development of 2-substituted thiazole and benzothiazole compositions aimed at treating diseases characterized by DUX4 misexpression. These compounds can be administered alone or with other agents, highlighting their focus on innovative treatments for specific inflammatory diseases.

overview_description.description:
Altay Therapeutics is a biotech company focused on finding and discovering small molecule therapies for chronic inflammatory conditions. It is currently focused on finding curative therapies for fibrosis, NASH, and liver cancer. It develops novel small molecule drugs against transcriptional regulators that are validated drivers of disease. 

It was founded in 2019 and is headquartered in San Francisco, California.
